RoomType.rationale: InfestedPrismsElite.cs:10 => RoomType.Elite. "infested_prisms" sits in `_hive_rooms().elite_keys` and nowhere else. No `Tags` override in the C#, and "infested_prisms" is correspondingly absent from `_hive_rooms().tags` -- consistent.

ExtraAssetPaths.maps_to: no counterpart -- sim has no texture/overlay rendering
ExtraAssetPaths.rationale: InfestedPrismsElite.cs:12 returns the `Tainted` affliction's overlay texture path (`ModelDb.Affliction<Tainted>().OverlayPath`) -- a single asset for pre-loading the visual overlay this encounter's `VitalSparkPower` inflicts on the player's Skills. This is a rendering-asset list consumed only by `EncounterModel.GetAssetPaths` for scene pre-loading; the sim has no texture pipeline and no headless equivalent. No gameplay behavior depends on it.

AllPossibleMonsters.maps_to: no per-encounter counterpart; full_env.py::_monster_classes() (global Monster-subclass walk)
AllPossibleMonsters.rationale: InfestedPrismsElite.cs:14 declares a single-element list containing only `InfestedPrism`, exactly GenerateMonsters' one draw. Same consumer census as the rest of the batch: the property's only two real readers are UI/debug surfaces (dev-console unlock list, bestiary ratio), absent from the headless sim; the sim's real vocabulary need is met by the global `_monster_classes()` walk. Cost: none observed.

GenerateMonsters.rationale: InfestedPrismsElite.cs:16-19: a single `InfestedPrism` instance, `null` slot, zero RNG draws. `infested_prism.py` does not override `create_monsters`; `INFESTED_PRISMS_ELITE = Encounter(id="infested_prisms_elite", monster_classes=[InfestedPrism])` relies on the base class, producing `[InfestedPrism(hooks, rng)]`, no slot assignment, zero draws off `selection_rng`. Roster, order, slot and draw count all match.

ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.rationale: `EncounterModel.cs:39` default (`=> false`), not overridden by the sealed `InfestedPrismsElite`. The sim's `Encounter` is never a hook listener.

guards.what: Gold ladder (MinGoldReward/MaxGoldReward) and ShouldGiveRewards -- both inherited, not overridden by InfestedPrismsElite
guards.rationale: RoomType.Elite => 35-45 gold, matched by `rewards.py:170-173`'s `GOLD_REWARD_RANGES[RoomType.ELITE]` (non-ascension baseline). `ShouldGiveRewards` default `true` matched by `Encounter.should_give_rewards`'s dataclass default, unmodified by `INFESTED_PRISMS_ELITE`.
